tubuild reconcile note: the generated preamble was discarded and the TU hand-curated, so none of the conflict markers the warnings above were frozen against are present in src_tu/actors/d_a_mip.cpp. Each was reconciled deliberately rather than by picking a side. FUNCTION declarations were reduced to ONE signature per symbol in a single file-scope extern "C" region -- a class member function may not sit inside a linkage specification, so there is no other place to put them -- and the reconciled spelling is the widest that keeps every call site's codegen: pointer parameters became void *, and two return types were forced by use rather than by majority (Sound::PlaySub and _Z14ApproachLinearRsss are tested in an `if` by StateTalkMain, so the `void` three of the four legacy files declared cannot be right, and RandomIntInternal is unsigned because InitResources shifts its result right by 8 and the ROM uses LSR). DATA declarations were NOT reconciled: each stays block-scope inside the member that recovered it, because the legacy files genuinely disagreed about the shape of the same ov085 statics -- 0x021305c0 alone was spelled int[], struct G { int w[2]; }, an incomplete struct S, void *[] and plain char -- and mwccarm leaves a file-scope variable's name unmangled in C++, so a block-scope extern still names the ROM symbol. The two shadow-type conflicts went the same way: the Vector3 and Fix12 typedefs stay inside their own members. The two RAW warnings are likewise resolved -- both bodies were carried out of their legacy extern "C" blocks and are now real daMip_c methods. Marked (RESOLVED) rather than deleted, so the record that the legacy files disagreed about these names survives. Checked by tools/check_tubuild_conflicts.py.

linkcheck note: `tools/tubuild.py linkcheck ov085/daMip_c` cannot be the pre-promotion proof for THIS TU, and the reason is structural rather than a failure of the fold. The promotion carries a symbol rename -- 23 auto-named ov085 members become daMip_c methods in config/arm9/overlays/ov085/symbols.txt -- so there is no intermediate tree state that links: before the rename the merged TU defines names symbols.txt does not carry, and after it the 32 legacy shards define names it no longer carries. Once the spliced delinks entry exists, tubuild.py:4641 classifies the source as an already-enrolled intact-object candidate and routes it through tu_production.prepare_intact_object, which refuses a .text-only claim.
